sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Vessel Hull and Cargo Damage Marine Claims Inspection Survey

stage_1.expense_line_item: INPI Guichet unique — electronic filing of incorporation (création d'entreprise, RCS + RBE declaration)
stage_1.charging_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle)
stage_1.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (approx. €41.24 per INPI fee schedule 2024)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title III, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL formation, capital, management and registration), L.210-1 et seq. (general commercial company provisions), and R.223-1 et seq. (registration formalities).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprise operated by the INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle), with underlying RCS registration by the Greffe du tribunal de commerce for the company's registered office.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Dossier unique de création d'entreprise (formulaire M0 / déclaration de création), filed electronically at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The law imposes no prescribed minimum capital; the articles may fix capital at any positive amount. Cash contributions must be paid up to at least one-fifth at subscription, with the balance due within five years of registration, unless a higher early payment is chosen. Prior to registration, cash capital must be deposited in a blocked account with a bank, the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or a notary; funds are released after the company is registered.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, at the initial meeting of the shareholders of Marine Survey France SARL, that: (1) the draft articles of association are unanimously approved as submitted; (2) each founding shareholder irrevocably subscribes to the shares allocated in the articles, and the total share subscription and initial capital contributions are accepted; (3) the registered office is fixed at [street, city, France]; (4) the social purpose is strictly limited to marine hull and cargo damage survey and related technical inspection; (5) Mr./Ms. [name] is appointed first gérant with sole signature authority for a non-fixed term; and (6) the gérant is authorized to execute all registration, licensing and banking formalities necessary to obtain the Kbis extract.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and signature of articles of association and appointment of first gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders; optional notary if an in-kind contribution consists of real property or a regulated asset
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Cause the shareholders to sign and date the statuts (articles of association), which must state the corporate form SARL, corporate purpose, duration, capital, registered-office address, share subscription terms, first gérant appointment and the manager's powers. Have each shareholder initial each page. If the registered office is a location other than the manager's domicile, obtain the landlord's written consent. If any contribution includes real property or shares, record the contribution before a notary in a notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Signed articles of association (statuts)
Shareholders' subscription certificate or were payment list
Manager's signed consent to hold office
Landlord's written authorization if registered office is not owned by the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries a missing or invalid clause, amend the statuts by unanimous shareholders' decision before filing; a notary may correct formal errors or clarify in-kind contribution valuations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of subscribed share capital and obtaining funds-blocking attestation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed French credit institution, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the company's name with a French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, transfer the cash portion of the subscribed capital, and obtain a certificate of deposit of funds (attestation de dépôt des fonds) attesting blocked custody until registration. If capital consists of in-kind assets, annex the valuation report to the articles and no cash deposit is required for that value.
required_dossiers: Draft or preliminary articles of association
Subscriber identity documents
Share subscription declaration for each cash contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account opening or requests additional AML/KYC documents, resubmit the required certificates to a licensed French credit institution or use the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations as the receiving authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of legal notice in authorized legal-announcement journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized in the département of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish a legal notice in a newspaper authorized by law for legal announcements in the département where the registered office is located. The notice must include company name, legal form, capital, registered-office address, corporate purpose, duration, and first manager's name. Obtain the attestation de parution issued by the JAL.
required_dossiers: Proposed legal notice text
Copy of the draft articles of association if requested by the JAL
Manager's authorization letter for publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the publication attestation is delayed or contains errors, request a corrected attestation and possibly republish; choose another eligible JAL in the same département if the first journal cannot meet the statutory timetable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic submission of the single formation file to INPI Guichet unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI – Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprise at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the official Guichet unique portal and complete the online creation declaration corresponding to the M0 dossier. Indicate the activity as marine cargo and hull damage surveying, auxiliary maritime transport services, and the APE/NAF classification for that scope. Upload all required attachments, sign electronically, and validate the declaration. The INPI transmits the dossier to the RCS registry, tax authorities, social security bodies and INSEE.
required_dossiers: Signed articles of association
Certificate of cash capital deposit
Legal-announcement attestation
Declaration of beneficial owner (personne physiquement bénéficiaire)
Manager's identity document
Manager's declaration of absence of disqualification from management
Proof of occupation of registered premises
Electronic M0 creation form / declarant mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the INPI or the registry sends an incompleteness notice, correct the declaration and attach the missing documents online within the specified cure period; the registry may reject only if formal deficiencies are not cured, in which case refile a fresh dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration at the RCS and issuance of Kbis extract and SIREN/SIRET codes
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce / Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the registry verifies the dossier, the company receives its registration certificate and the Kbis extract, which evidences legal personality. INSEE issues the SIREN and SIRET identifiers. The registry records the legal form, registered office, managers, corporate object and the APE code. After receiving the Kbis extract, release and transfer the blocked capital funds to the company's definitive bank account.
required_dossiers: INPI validation receipt / acknowledgment of receipt
Completed RCS transmission created by the Guichet unique
Payment of any registry incidental fees where applicable (no mandatory state filing fee)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis information is incorrect or a third party objects to the registration, request a rectification before the commercial registry; judicial recourse may be taken before the competent court for a formal annulment or correction.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de la Mer et de la Transition écologique – Direction Générale des Affaires Maritimes, de la Pêche et de l'Aquaculture (DGAMPA); local DREAL for ICPE-classified installations
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Inscription sur la liste nationale des experts maritimes / agrément d'expert maritime issued by ministerial order, supplemented where relevant by ISO 17020 inspection-body accreditation for marine cargo condition and hull damage assessment

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition écologique, de l'Énergie, du Climat et de la Vie; Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL), Inspection des Installations Classées (ICPE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category: declaration (régime de déclaration) for ordinary office and inspection premises. Full EIA is not required for a pure marine surveying service using only office and on-board inspections. A full environmental impact assessment will be triggered only if the company operates a dry dock, workshop or waste-processing facility exceeding ICPE thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For any wastewater discharge to the public sewer, comply with the municipal pre-treatment ordinance, typically pH 5.5-8.5, temperature below 30°C, suspended solids below 600 mg/l, BOD5 below 500 mg/l and COD below 1000 mg/l. No VOC-related process is expected; any cleaning solvent use must respect REACH and the EU Solvent Emissions Directive. Oily cargo residues, ballast water and port waste encountered during vessel surveys must be delivered to port reception facilities under Directive (EU) 2019/883. Hazardous waste must be tracked through a licensed disposal channel and by register.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain a fire safety certificate (avis de conformité / commission de sécurité) from the préfecture or an approved inspection body for any premises accessible to staff or the public. Where survey equipment is stored, verify the structure's load-bearing capacity and maintain an inspection register. Register the workplace with the occupational health service, obtain medical fitness certificates for employees, submit the mandatory prior hiring declarations to URSSAF, and perform periodic workplace safety evaluations and health and safety training.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances; official portal: impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For an FR SARL, the statutory TIN is assigned upon incorporation through the Centre de Formalités des Entreprises (CFE), filed via guichet-entreprises.fr. The company receives a SIREN, SIRET and code APE/NAF, and is automatically registered for French VAT by the DGFiP, which allocates a Numéro de TVA Intracommunautaire (format FR + SIREN). Foreign entities not established in France must submit Form SI to the DGFiP and, for non-EU entities, appoint an accredited tax representative; supporting documents include constitutive acts, proof of address and business purpose.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France has no check-the-box election. An SARL is by default subject to entity-level French corporate income tax (IS). Under CGI Article 239 bis AA, a 'SARL de famille' composed exclusively of natural persons may elect, for a limited renewable period, to be treated as a tax-transparent partnership taxed at the personal income tax (IR) level. Hybrid mismatch adjustments under ATAD are mandatory, not elective, and are implemented through Articles 205 A et seq. CGI.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (TVA – Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Service providers: €37,500 annual turnover; goods suppliers: €85,000 annual turnover (franchise en base, CGI Art. 293 B). Exceeding the relevant threshold, or the two-year rolling average, triggers mandatory VAT registration and invoicing obligations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Under the French e-invoicing reform, from 1 September 2026 all French VAT-registered businesses must receive structured electronic invoices and large/mid-size businesses must issue them; from 1 September 2027 small businesses, including SARLs, must issue e-invoices. Transmission must occur through the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) or a certified Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire (PDP) using structured formats (FACTUR-X, UBL). Transaction data and VAT reporting must be transmitted to DGFiP in real time or periodically via PPF APIs; there is no separate digital stamping, but continuous transaction controls apply.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% TVA) applies to goods physically transported outside the EU, subject to proof of export under CGI Art. 262 ter I. Marine cargo survey and inspection services supplied to non-resident underwriters qualify as outside the scope of French VAT under the B2B place-of-supply rule (CGI Art. 259-1) where the customer is established outside France. Services directly connected to exported goods may also be zero-rated if the services are performed on or in relation to those goods and are evidenced by export documentation. The claimant must demonstrate the non-French establishment of the customer and the direct link to the export transaction.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU / Electronic Export Declaration) validated by French Customs
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or CMR evidencing transport out of the European Union
Commercial invoice and packing list describing the goods or services
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT/ bank transfer confirmation proving receipt of export proceeds
Marine surveyor's damage inspection report or certificate of insurance loss
Customer's written confirmation of non-French establishment, including VAT registration number where available
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGFiP may reassess erroneous zero-rating claims within three years (extended to six years in cases of fraud or obstruction). Improperly claimed zero-rating is clawed back together with late-payment interest at 0.2% per month and penalties of 40% for negligence or 80% for bad faith or dissimulation under CGI Articles 1728 and 1729. Fraudulent export claims may also trigger criminal penalties under CGI Article 1741, including fines up to €75,000 and imprisonment of up to five years. The taxpayer bears the burden of substantiating the export and the non-French status of the customer, and must prove timely repatriation of foreign currency proceeds within the 180-day deadline.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) under the European System of Central Banks; prudential supervision is exercised through the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution); foreign exchange and balance-of-payments regulatory reporting is collected and validated by Banque de France under the framework of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier, CMF) and delegated EU powers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a euro-area member with full current-account and capital-account convertibility in euros. Capital movements, payments and transfers inside the EU and with third countries are unrestricted under Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Articles L. 511-1 and R. 151-1 et seq. of the CMF, subject only to EU/UN sanctions, temporary safeguard measures, and the foreign-investment screening regime (Code monétaire et financier, Article L. 151-3) for strategic sectors, which do not capture marine cargo surveying activities as currently classified. Profit repatriation is lawful and receives no surrender or conversion constraint; practical hurdles are documentary rather than convertibility barriers, including FATCA/CRS declarations, KYC on beneficial owners, and balance-of-payments reporting through the intermediary credit institution.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender requirement, mandatory conversion ratio, or forced repatriation deadline applicable to export receipts in France. EUR proceeds arising in France need no declaration as such; foreign-currency proceeds (e.g. USD, GBP) may be retained in designated FX accounts at a licensed credit institution. However, all cross-border payments above the administrative information threshold must be reported by the intermediate French bank to Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistics under Articles R. 152-1-1 to R. 152-1-5 of the CMF, and parties holding foreign accounts or executing high-value transactions must maintain documentary support of the commercial underlying.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole CIB (Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Medium for auxiliary receipts, Low for core treasury. A French-licensed electronic money institution under ACPR/PSD2 may provide operational payment accounts for low-value surveyor fee collection, but cannot replace a banking license for credit facilities, capital escrow deposits, or complex trade settlement. Non-EU digital EMIs (including Wise and Payoneer) are legally usable for inbound professional fees from foreign underwriters but present elevated KYC and clearing risk, cannot accept escrow deposits, and lack Banque de France BOP reporting responsibility, shifting documentary burden to the SARL. Use of EMIs should be limited to complementary collection rails while tier-1 bank accounts remain the primary treasury spine.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Most tier-1 French banks require a physical interview at a Commercial Bank branch with the legal representative (gérant) for the first corporate account opening, especially when any beneficial owner resides outside the EEA. Remote opening is available only under conditions: the gérant must hold a valid French electronic identity with remote video verification accepted by the bank's compliance function, and the corporate file must contain no non-EEA PEP exposure. For non-resident gérants, the physical appearance requirement is near-mandatory; an apostilled power of attorney can be accepted for supporting signatories but not for the statutory KYC interview. The marine insurance surveyor license and the attestation de dépôt of the capital escrow account must be presented at onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EEA concentration of ultimate beneficial owners or indirect corporate chain requiring look-through verification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete beneficial-owner register (registre des bénéficiaires effectifs), notarized articles of association, K-bis extract, passport and residence proof of each UBO exceeding 25% interest, group ownership chart, tax residence certificates, source-of-wealth declaration, sanctions and AML screening results, and a signed commitment to notify any future UBO change under Article L. 561-2-2 of the CMF.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting flows from provisional and non-resident marine underwriters generating unexplained high-frequency incoming wire volume
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory license of marine insurance surveyor (certificat de capacité or license under relevant codes), audited financial statements, client and counterparty register with business rationale, sample signed surveyor engagement contracts, invoice schedule matching payment messages, internal AML risk assessment showing the Low-Risk_Standard tier, and transaction trail mapping to named insurance principals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection or loan from the parent/related party paid by a third-party payer rather than the registered shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized attestation de dépôt of the temporary blocked capital account, sworn declaration of subscriptions (déclaration de souscription et de versement), signed shareholder minutes, bank statement of the actual payer matching the deposit amount, IBAN in the sole name of the investor, a written rationale for the payment chain, and origin-of-funds evidence covering the full route to the French beneficiary account.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for SARL capital injection uses SEPA Credit Transfer via TARGET2 for EEA-origin EUR funds and SWIFT MT103 for non-EEA or hard-currency funds, with the following control points: the remitter must transmit from its own bank account with matching IBAN; the reference field carries the corporate contract or share-subscription reference; the receiving bank requires the SARL's LEI, SIREN/SIRET, EORI-VAT number, and standard settlement instructions. The Banque de France balance-of-payments purpose code for direct investment capital contributions is applied by the bank under the foreign-direct-investment statistical category (capital-in-kind/subscribed capital), and the account designation must clearly flag the temporary blocked status mandated for SARL formation under Articles L. 223-7 and R. 223-3 of the French Commercial Code (Code de commerce).
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: EUR trade settlements up to standard thresholds are cleared through SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) and, for urgent low-value disbursements or underwriting advance payments, SEPA Instant; high-value euro transfers are settled via TARGET2. For non-EEA trade disbursements, SWIFT MT103 with correspondent cover through MT202 is the standard corporate banking rail. Documentary trade settlements for marine cargo claims and surveyor services are executed under Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600) using MT700 issuance and MT754 acceptance; an Incoterms-aligned and contract-referenced invoice package, certificate of survey, loss-adjustment statement, and bank-compliant transport-document set must accompany each drawing. All outbound payments are reported by the French intermediary bank to Banque de France for BOP statistical purposes.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla EUR/USD forward contracts (outright delivery or cash-settled) for underwriting fee receipts
EUR/GBP and EUR/CHF commercial forwards for trade settlements to London-based insurance markets
Cross-currency swaps (coupon- and principal-exchange) matched to firm trade disbursement schedules
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with OECD-domiciled counterparties for illiquid emerging-market currencies where physical delivery is impracticable
Currency options (call/put and zero-cost collars) for hedging adverse exchange-rate windows on forecast receivables

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and Direction des Services Fiscaux
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 3 months after the end of the fiscal year (e.g. 31 March for calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 1,500 EUR for late filing; non-compliance may result in court-ordered dissolution after formal notice

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if SARL exceeds two of: turnover > 800,000 EUR, balance sheet total > 400,000 EUR, or >50 employees

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial owners (DBE) declaration must be updated upon changes in shareholding or control; no annual confirmation required

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 100-500 USD (typical registered office or agent services)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit for small enterprises (annual revenue below EUR 10 million, capital fully paid up, at least 75% held by individuals); standard 25% applies to the excess. A 3.3% social contribution may apply on taxable profit exceeding EUR 763,000, producing a top marginal aggregate rate of approximately 25.825%. Marine insurance surveying enjoys no CIT tax holiday; eligible R&D in survey methodologies or digital tools may qualify for the Crédit d'Impôt Recherche / Crédit d'Impôt Innovation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065-SD (Déclaration de résultats – Impôt sur les Sociétés) submitted as part of the annual liasse fiscale through the EFI module (Espace Professionnel / EDI-TDFC) on impots.gouv.fr.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (one return per fiscal year; quarterly IS instalments are due by 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December, with the balance payable at the filing deadline).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a fiscal year ending on 31 December, filing must occur on or before 3 May of the following year, adjusted to the next business day if that date falls on a weekend or public holiday. For any other fiscal year-end, the deadline is the second business day following the expiry of the three-month period after the close of the fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: French 9-digit SIREN identification number, legal name, SARL legal form, registered office address and NAF/APE activity code allocated by INSEE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory for a 100% foreign-owned SARL; foreign shareholder identities are declared separately in the beneficial-ownership register; no French tax representative is required for ordinary CIT filing by a SARL.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 0A (Bénéfice net comptable) / Box 0B (Perte nette comptable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting net profit or loss of the fiscal year before tax adjustments, derived from the statutory French GAAP financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Figures must reconcile with audited or certified accounts; keep intercompany reconciliations available for use in audit defence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back of non-deductible expenses (fines, excess vehicle costs, non-deductible entertainment) and deduction of items such as IP amortisation eligible for the patent-box regime.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Avoid treating parent-company invoices as deductions without economic substance; apply Article 57 CGI arm's-length adjustments when preparing the taxable base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable profit after applying tax-loss carryforwards, or the net operating loss available for future carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-parented SARLs must respect the annual cap on loss carryforward use: EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000; losses from a foreign permanent establishment are not deductible in France.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or non-filing triggers a 10% penalty on the tax due, increased to 20% after a written demand, 40% if not filed within 30 days of formal notice, and 80% for concealed activity; monthly late-payment interest of 0.20% accrues in all cases under Article 1727 CGI.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% statutory withholding on French-source dividends paid to non-resident corporate shareholders (Article 119 bis 2 CGI); 12.8% for non-resident individual shareholders, excluding the effect of any additional social levies. Distributions require a shareholder resolution and must be reported in the annual 2065 return.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To obtain treaty relief, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a tax residence certificate (TRC / Form 5000) from its home tax administration and deliver it to the French SARL before the payment date so that the reduced or zero treaty rate can be applied at source. For EU parent companies, Article 119 ter CGI provides an exemption from dividend withholding where the entity holds at least 10% of the SARL's capital for at least two years (or undertakes to do so), subject to beneficial-ownership and anti-abuse confirmation. If a treaty rate was incorrectly applied at source, the shareholder may file Form 5001 (recours gracieux) with the DRFIP of the payer's locality within the statutory limitation period, generally until 31 December of the second year following the year of collection.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 33.33% under Article 182 C CGI; 0% under the EU Interest & Royalties Directive for qualifying related EU entities; treaty rates range from 0% to 15%. Interest: generally 0% statutory withholding for arm's-length interest, but a 75% punitive withholding applies to interest paid to entities in non-cooperative jurisdictions (ETNC / French blacklist).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 50,000,000 (French entity annual revenue or gross fixed assets triggering Local File and Master File obligations under Article L13 AA LPF); OECD CbC Report threshold is EUR 750,000,000 consolidated group revenue. SMEs (under the EU definition) are exempt from formal TP documentation but must still comply with the arm's-length principle.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France does not operate an offshore-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) code. Substance is nevertheless decisive through the abuse-of-law procedure (Article L.64 LPF), the sham/simulation doctrine, Article 57 CGI recharacterisation of intercompany arrangements, the EU Parent-Subsidiary and Interest & Royalties anti-abuse clauses, and the EU ATAD/Unshell (ATAD 3) initiatives. A marine insurance surveyor SARL must demonstrate genuine management, qualified personnel, premises, client contracts, professional indemnity cover and local decision-making to preserve treaty and EU directive benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate concealment of survey fee or premium income, issuance of fake invoices, double-bookkeeping, or knowingly filing a false 2065 return that understates taxable profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to EUR 500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years under Article 1741 CGI; aggravated forms (organised gang or combined with laundering) carry up to EUR 1,500,000 fine and 7 years' imprisonment; civil reassessment with an 80% bad-faith penalty plus 0.20% monthly late interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The gérant may be jointly liable for the company's evasion penalties under Article L.267 LPF; criminal conviction triggers interdiction de gérer, travel bans, freezing of personal assets and possible extradition exposure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A French SARL lacking real personnel, premises or the required marine surveyor licensing, used solely as a conduit to channel dividends and survey fees to a tax-haven parent while claiming treaty benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation under Article 155 A CGI and the abuse-of-law doctrine (Article L.64 LPF) with an 80% penalty and denial of treaty and EU directive benefits; the tax administration may also apply the 75% withholding on payments to non-cooperative jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The gérant who created or managed the artificial arrangement may be held personally liable for the restated tax debt; a criminal court can impose an interdiction décennale de gérer and sanctions for organised tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Invoicing marine survey services at sub-economic rates to a related foreign underwriter, mispricing engineering hours, performing offshore fee-splitting with no subcontract justification, or failing to produce a defensible pricing file.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 57 CGI permits recharacterisation of profits transferred abroad, giving rise to additional corporate income tax, a 40% bad-faith penalty and monthly interest; failure to present the TP file within 30 days of a request adds a fine of up to 10% of the reassessed tax under Article 1735 ter A CGI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who knowingly executed the mispricing risks criminal complicity in tax evasion, personal recovery of the reassessment under the abuse-of-law and management-fault regime (Article L.223-22 Code de commerce), and suspension from commercial management.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Laundering of Illicit Insurance Claim Proceeds
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Collusion with insured parties or claimants to certify exaggerated hull or cargo damage, accepting kickbacks for favourable survey reports, or channelling such proceeds through offshore accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering of insurance fraud proceeds is punishable by up to 5 years' imprisonment and a EUR 375,000 fine under Article 324-1 Code pénal; aggravated laundering by an organised gang or through the company's professional activity carries up to 10 years and EUR 750,000, plus confiscation of assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The gérant and signing surveyors face criminal conviction, removal from the maritime experts register, civil damages to underwriters, seizure of personal and corporate property, and automatic commercial disqualification under Article L.653-8 Code de commerce.
